notes: Rows 1-11 of the copy carry lines 1-9 (raised 1-9 inside the rows); lines 10-18 each have their own row with the line number at the right margin (line 13 has no signs; 'all blank' in line 18 is Griffith's note, not signs). Numerals written as digits: the vertical stroke = 1 (after each pesatê name), '———|||' = 13, '———┐' = 15, following his rendering. Brackets in this copy are drawn mirrored (the ']' on the right opens a restoration). A vertical connector line runs from line 17 down to line 18 in the copy. Contamination: the overview crop of this copy includes the first line of his rendering ('Extended invocation to Isis and Osiris.') and p. 647 (read in step 2 of Faras 42) gives 44's invocation; both were seen before step 1. The step-1 reading of the left parts of rows 9-10 and of lines 10-18 was rough and partly made after his rendering was open; treat 'first' there as not independent. Rendering continues on p645 (printed p. 597).
